Covers slide structure, text hierarchy, swipe psychology, and platform-specific specs. Use for: carousel posts, Instagram carousels, LinkedIn carousels, slide posts, educational content. copy.tagline: 设计多页轮播图用于社交媒体发帖
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为Instagram、LinkedIn等平台制作吸引人的轮播图帖子。
copy.tagline_en: Design multi-slide carousels for social media posts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create engaging carousel posts for Instagram, LinkedIn, and other platforms.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你提供的主题和内容，生成适用于 Instagram、LinkedIn、Twitter/X 等平台的轮播图设计，包括每张幻灯片的 HTML 代码，并遵循布局规则和文案技巧。
howto.when: 当你要求制作轮播图、Instagram 轮播、LinkedIn 轮播、幻灯片帖子或教育类内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个关于“5个CSS技巧”的Instagram轮播图。
为LinkedIn制作一个案例研究轮播，主题是“从0到100万ARR”。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate multi-slide carousel designs for Instagram, LinkedIn, and Twitter/X based on your topic and content, including HTML code for each slide, following layout rules and copywriting hooks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create a carousel, Instagram carousel, LinkedIn carousel, slide post, or educational content.

say_en.text: Design an Instagram carousel about '5 CSS tricks'.
say_en.note: Claude will generate HTML for 7 slides including hook, content, and CTA.

say_en.text: Create a LinkedIn case study carousel on '0 to $1M ARR'.
Generate a Twitter/X carousel showing '10 tools every designer needs', 2 tools per slide.
say_en.note: Claude will produce 5 content slides plus hook and CTA, total 7 slides.
